title: "Hiding in Plain Sight": Designing Synthetic Dialog Generation for Uncovering Socially Situated Norms
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It focuses on uncovering and evaluating socially situated norms in conversations.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as it is not a focus of the research.
